newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico phone union seeks 47 pct wage hike - report.
newsitem.headline: Mexico phone union seeks 47 pct wage hike - report.

text.p: Mexico's main telephone workers union on Monday demanded a 47.43 percent wage hike but delayed making a formal strike threat until Wednesday to give Telefonos de Mexico (Telmex) a chance to respond, state news agency Notimex reported.
Eduardo Torres, spokesman for the Telephone Workers' Union of the Mexican Republic said it expected Telmex to make a counter-offer on Tuesday and that the union's demand was negotiable.
If Telmex's offer is insufficient, the union's 50,000 members would go on strike on April 25, Notimex quoted him as saying, although he added that he expected Telmex to show goodwill.
Telmex is Mexico's main phone company and is by far the largest company listed on the Mexican stock market. It has rarely been hit by strike action.
